timestamp_timeout.description: Timeout in minutes before sudo password caching expires. 0 means no caching.

pwfeedback.description: If true, enables password character feedback (asterisks) during sudo password entry.

admin_groups.description: List of group names granted full sudo access. Names should not include the '%' prefix in the template logic, but the template renders them as group directives.

permissions.description: List of specific permission rules. Each rule is a flat object with fields: target (user or group prefixed with %), hosts, runas (user:group format, empty for any), commands (comma-separated command paths). If commands is a list in input, it is joined by comma. If runas is empty string, template outputs (ALL). If runas has content, template outputs (content). If hosts is empty, template outputs ALL.
